title: Deepdrift — Seeded Pocket Roguelike
description: Ten floors of a collapsing mine, generated from a seed you can share — three delvers, real fog of war, turn-based to the last hit point.
concept: A full turn-based roguelike in one file. Pick one of three delvers, each with its own stat line and signature power, then dive ten procedurally generated floors lit by recursive shadowcasting. Every floor is derived from hash(seed, depth), so a shared seed link drops a friend into byte-identical dungeons. Fight, loot, and upgrade your way to the Drift Warden on floor ten; die and the run gets scored, saved to a local leaderboard, and exported as a PNG run card.
features: Three playable classes — Warden (Bulwark), Prowler (Dash), Adept (Arc) — with distinct stats, sight radius and cooldown powers
Procedural dungeon generation seeded per-floor from hash(seed, depth), so any seed reproduces all ten floors exactly
Recursive shadowcasting field of view with warm torchlight, cold explored-memory palette and remembered-tile fog
Turn-based combat against five scaling monster types plus a boss that gates the final stairwell
Consumables (mending draught, blast charge, shift stone) and permanent pickups (edge shards, scale plates, drift gems)
Seed share links via URL hash, plus a copy-to-clipboard button with an execCommand fallback
Run card PNG export drawn on an offscreen canvas — score, depth, kills, gems and seed
localStorage top-8 leaderboard, resumable in-progress run, and remembered class preference

interaction.mouse: Click a tile to step one square toward it; click the stairs you are standing on to descend
interaction.click: Class cards, seed roll/daily buttons, power and item buttons, share link and run card export
interaction.touch: Nine-key directional pad with a wait centre, plus power, three item buttons and descend
interaction.keyboard: WASD / arrows / hjkl+yubn to move and attack, space to wait, e for your power, 1-3 for items, > to descend
